Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-transcribe-medium-0017", "row_sha256": "95eb80873b8d694506203d0efdef9d48128e5e7cc51700f28dda7c135f60107f", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "i'm forwarding the revised prep list to the evening crew before the doors open the kitchen shift starts at four and we have twenty eight volunteers on the sign in sheet two people are assigned to wash carrots and celery one person is checking the canned tomatoes for damaged seals and the soup station needs three clean ladles first set the lentil pot on the back burner and keep the printed temperature log beside it next put the dairy free labels on the green tray not the blue one the blue tray is for rolls from the bakery van the driver said he will arrive around five fifteen so please leave the side entrance clear we still need to count the paper bowls and bring the extra gloves from the dry storage shelf if the delivery of parsley is late use the chopped parsley in the freezer and write that change on the board nina has the key for the walk in cooler and will lock it after the last meal is packed i can stay until six thirty but i need to leave before the volunteer briefing at seven the allergy binder is in the top drawer by the sink and the sign in sheet should go back into the red folder when the shift ends", "output": "I'm forwarding the revised prep list to the evening crew before the doors open. The kitchen shift starts at four, and we have twenty-eight volunteers on the sign-in sheet. Two people are assigned to wash carrots and celery. One person is checking the canned tomatoes for damaged seals, and the soup station needs three clean ladles. First, set the lentil pot on the back burner and keep the printed temperature log beside it. Next, put the dairy-free labels on the green tray, not the blue one. The blue tray is for rolls from the bakery van. The driver said he will arrive around five fifteen, so please leave the side entrance clear. We still need to count the paper bowls and bring the extra gloves from the dry storage shelf. If the delivery of parsley is late, use the chopped parsley in the freezer and write that change on the board. Nina has the key for the walk-in cooler and will lock it after the last meal is packed. I can stay until six thirty, but I need to leave before the volunteer briefing at seven. The allergy binder is in the top drawer by the sink, and the sign-in sheet should go back into the red folder when the shift ends."}]
